Palm photos used by the photo-tool tests and screenshots (tests/fixtures/palms/).
All are real photos under free licences, resized and re-encoded as JPEG on 2026-09-26.
None is a PalmSays user or the owner. Found through the Openverse API.

right-palm.jpg, left-palm-mirrored.jpg (mirrored copy), right-palm-exif-rotated.jpg (same pixels stored
sideways with EXIF orientation 6), and src/lib/tools/hand/examples/right-palm.jpg (480 px copy shown as the
"example result" on the tool pages)

  https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/File:Right_Hand_Palm.png
  https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/4.0/
  Changes: transparent background filled white, resized, JPEG; the mirrored and rotated copies are derived.
  These derived copies are shared under the same licence (CC BY-SA 4.0).
